name: Slider

componentSettings.label: Layout
componentSettings.description: Component-local sizing for slide spacing, headings, controls and the mobile next-slide cue.

settings.label: Slide Gap
settings.description: Space between slides, measured in base units. A slider instance can override this through its gap parameter.

settings.label: Track Insets
settings.description: Horizontal inset inside the scroll track, measured in base units. A slider instance can override this through its padding parameter.

settings.label: Card Shadow Clearance
settings.description: Vertical room reserved around cards so their shadows remain visible, measured in base units.

settings.label: Next-slide Peek
settings.description: Visible width of the next card on compact sliders, measured in base units.

settings.label: Peek Edge Fade
settings.description: Width of the soft fade at the viewport edge, measured in base units.

settings.label: Preamble Measure
settings.description: Maximum readable line length for the slider preamble.

settings.label: Slide Content Maximum Width
settings.description: Maximum width of centered slide content, measured in base units.

settings.label: Segment Card Minimum Height
settings.description: Minimum height for card-layout segments inside a slider, measured in base units.

componentSettings.label: Header and Controls
componentSettings.description: Fine-tune the title row, touch target and autoplay control without changing global spacing tokens.

settings.label: Header Column Gap
settings.description: Space between title content and its navigation controls, measured in base units.

settings.label: Header Row Gap
settings.description: Space between title and preamble rows, measured in base units.

settings.label: Header Bottom Gap
settings.description: Space below the title area and above the slider track, measured in base units.

settings.label: Floating Control Offset
settings.description: Offset for floating navigation controls, measured in base units.

settings.label: Large Control Inset
settings.description: Inset for floating navigation controls in larger containers, measured in base units.

settings.label: Autoplay Control Size
settings.description: Size of the play/pause control, measured in base units.

settings.label: Autoplay Control Inset
settings.description: Inset for the play/pause control, measured in base units.

componentSettings.label: Motion
componentSettings.description: Controls local fade timing while preserving reduced-motion behavior.

settings.label: Slide Fade Duration
settings.description: Duration of the visibility fade used by ordinary slides.

settings.label: Peek Edge Fade Duration
settings.description: Duration of the edge-fade handoff when the final slide is reached.

settings.label: Autoplay Control Fade Duration
settings.description: Duration of the play/pause control reveal.

componentSettings.label: Colors
componentSettings.description: Component-local colors for navigation and the autoplay control.

settings.label: Navigation Color
settings.description: Controls the navigation icon color.

settings.label: Autoplay Control Background
settings.description: Controls the circular surface behind the play/pause icon.

settings.label: Overlay Color
settings.description: Controls the overlay tone for content slides.

settings.label: Overlay Opacity
settings.description: Controls the opacity of the slide content overlay.

description: A dependency-free, container-aware scroll-snap slider with native touch scrolling, keyboard navigation, autoplay, accessible controls, and component-local Design Center controls.
